listen_ip.description: IP address on which curvedns listens for incoming DNS queries (UDP/TCP).

listen_port.description: UDP/TCP port to listen on for incoming DNS queries (commonly 53 or 5353).

forward_host.description: Hostname or IP of the upstream recursive resolver (e.g., Unbound or systemd-resolved).

forward_port.description: Port of the upstream recursive resolver (usually 53).

chroot_path.description: Chroot directory for security hardening (empty = disabled).
